items.source: parserContext - the object encapsulating the current state of the parsing process; provides access to a BeanDefinitionRegistry
items.translation: parserContext - 封装当前解析过程状态的对象；提供对BeanDefinitionRegistry的访问

items.source: Central template method to actually parse the supplied Element into one or more BeanDefinitions.
items.translation: 中央模板方法用于实际解析提供的Element，将其转换为一个或多个BeanDefinitions。

items.source: element - the element that is to be parsed into one or more BeanDefinitions
items.translation: element - 要解析为一个或多个BeanDefinitions的元素

items.source: Use this BeanDefinitionParser implementation when you want to parse some arbitrarily complex XML into one or more BeanDefinitions. If you just want to parse some XML into a single BeanDefinition, you may wish to consider the simpler convenience extensions of this class, namely AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser and AbstractSimpleBeanDefinitionParser.
items.translation: 使用此 BeanDefinitionParser 实现，当您希望将任意复杂的 XML 解析为一个或多个 BeanDefinitions 时。如果您只想将 XML 解析为单个 BeanDefinition，则可以考虑使用此类的更简单的便捷扩展类，即 AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser 和 AbstractSimpleBeanDefinitionParser。

items.source: The default implementation registers the supplied bean with the supplied registry only if the isNested parameter is false, because one typically does not want inner beans to be registered as top level beans.
items.translation: 默认实现仅在 `isNested` 参数为 `false` 时，将提供的 `bean` 注册到提供的 `registry`，因为通常不希望将内部 bean 注册为顶层 bean。

items.source: Implementations must return the primary BeanDefinition that results from the parse if they will ever be used in a nested fashion (for example as an inner tag in a <property/> tag). Implementations may return null if they will not be used in a nested fashion.
items.translation: 实现必须返回解析后生成的主BeanDefinition，如果它们将在嵌套方式中使用（例如作为<property/>标签中的内部标签）。如果实现不会以嵌套方式使用，则可以返回null。

items.source: When using generation, a name is generated automatically. Otherwise, the ID is extracted from the "id" attribute, potentially with a fallback to a generated id.
items.translation: 使用 generation 时，会自动生成名称。否则，ID 将从 "id" 属性中提取，并可能回退到生成的 ID（通过fallback）。

items.source: Subclasses can override this method to control whether the supplied bean is actually even registered, or to register even more beans.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法来控制是否实际注册提供的 bean，或者注册更多 bean。

items.source: This implementation returns true by default; that is, an event will be fired when a bean definition has been completely parsed. Override this to return false in order to suppress the event.
items.translation: 此实现默认返回 `true`；也就是说，当 Bean 定义被完全解析时，将触发事件。若要抑制该事件，请重写此方法以返回 `false`。

items.source: Disabled by default; subclasses can override this to enable ID generation. Note that this flag is about always generating an ID; the parser won't even check for an "id" attribute in this case.
items.translation: 默认禁用；子类可以重写此设置以启用 ID 生成。请注意，此标志是关于始终生成 ID；在这种情况下，解析器甚至不会检查"id"属性。

items.source:
Disabled by default; subclasses can override this to enable ID generation
as fallback: The parser will first check for an "id" attribute in this case,
only falling back to a generated ID if no value was specified.
items.translation: 默认禁用；子类可以覆盖此设置以启用 ID 生成作为后备方案：在这种情况下，解析器将首先检查是否存在"id"属性，仅在未指定值时才回退到生成的 ID。

items.source:
Derived classes can override this method to supply any custom logic that
is to be executed after all the parsing is finished.
items.translation: 派生类可以重写此方法，以提供在解析完成后执行的任何自定义逻辑。

items.source: The default implementation is a no-op.
items.translation: 默认实现是一个空操作。

items.source: Parse the specified Element and register the resulting BeanDefinition(s) with the BeanDefinitionRegistry embedded in the supplied ParserContext.
items.translation: 解析指定的 Element，并将生成的 BeanDefinition(s) 注册到 BeanDefinitionRegistry 中，该 ParserContext 已嵌入其中。

items.source: Hook method called after the primary parsing of a BeanComponentDefinition but before the BeanComponentDefinition has been registered with a BeanDefinitionRegistry.
items.translation: 在主要解析 `BeanComponentDefinition` 之后、但在该 `BeanComponentDefinition` 注册到 `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 之前调用的钩子方法。

items.source: Register the supplied bean with the supplied registry.
items.translation: 将提供的 bean 注册到提供的 registry。
